symptom: describe page -> exec of six FactoryManagement pages (Mendix 11.16) failed: a markdown viewer in an inner data view was refused "`GenAICommons.Span.Output` is an attribute of GenAICommons.Span, not of ConversationalUI.CopyHelper … CE7247" (and Span_TextGeneration_SlideIn's markdownViewer3 failed "failed to resolve mapping for stringAttribute"); an attribute-based visibility condition failed "ConversationalUI.TraceView has no attribute HasError".
file: mdl/executor/cmd_pages_parameter_binding.go (namedObjectSourceName, isNamedObjectAttributeText), cmd_pages_describe_pluggable.go and cmd_pages_describe_parse.go (print $dv.Attr / $dv/Assoc/Attr), cmd_pages_builder_v3.go (namedObjectVariable, used by resolveRootedAssociationPath), widget_engine.go (parameterBinding takes a data view; rootedAttributeBinding; BuildContext.AttributeSteps), widget_expression_value.go and validate_widget_expression_value.go (rooted data-source form on an attribute property), cmd_pages_builder_visible_when.go, cmd_pages_input_binding_context.go (MDL-WIDGET34 accepts an enclosing data view), mdl/backend (WidgetObjectBuilder.SetAttributeWithSteps in widgetobj and mcp). Tests: cmd_pages_outer_dataview_binding_2107_test.go
cause: Studio Pro stores both bindings with the data-view pair SourceVariable {Widget: <outer data view>, PageParameter: …} (markdownViewer3 also with association steps). parameterSourceName returns "" when Widget is set, so describe fell back to the qualified name and the rewrite resolved it against the nearest container. The `$dataView1.Attr` spelling existed for built-in inputs only (#826); the pluggable engine, Visible-by-attribute and MDL-WIDGET34 accepted a parameter only, and no pluggable attribute property could store association steps at all.
insight: **When a describe falls back to a qualified name, look for a SourceVariable the reader ignored.** Every one of these bindings carried the pair, and the existing spelling for it just had not been wired into every reader and writer: grep the parameter-only helpers (parameterSourceName, parameterVariable) for their callers, and widen them in ONE helper (namedObjectVariable, namedObjectSourceName) so check, describe and exec agree. Also note that `$x/Assoc/Attr` parses as an association data source, not an expression: a fix tested only through the expression form passes its unit test and still fails the real page (MDL-WIDGET42) - feed the engine the parsed shape. Controls: reverting each edit fails its test; the old binary refuses all six pages, the new one reports Unchanged page on all six; a fresh page with $dvOuter.Output, $dvOuter/Span_Trace/SystemPrompt and Visible: $dvOuter.Flag in (true) builds with mx check 0 errors on 11.16.
